name: KD-24 Auditory Provocation Drone
description: The KD-24 Auditory Provocation Drone was a model of probe droid that was used by the freelance spy known as the Shroud. It was equipped with sonic devices designed to attract and provoke local wildlife, and KD-24 drones were deployed to sic animals on individuals who were intruding on the Shroud's business.
